typicalBarText: Lead and staff bar requires multi-team technical vision, company-wide architecture governance, strategic technology roadmaps, and direct partnership with executive leadership to de-risk high-stakes initiatives.
checklistItems: Multi-year technical roadmaps aligning multiple squads with company goals
Architecture review board (ARB) leadership and security/compliance governance
Direct executive alignment with VP/CTO on technology investments
Enterprise-scale multi-region high availability and platform reliability
expectedSignals: Multi-team technical vision and strategic roadmapping
High-stakes organizational engineering impact and mentorship

scoredSignals.label: Multi-Team Technical Vision & Roadmaps
scoredSignals.description: Multi-quarter architectural vision aligning multiple engineering squads with company strategic goals.

scoredSignals.label: Architecture Governance & Risk Management
scoredSignals.description: Leading Architecture Review Boards (ARB), technology radar decisions, security postures, and disaster recovery.

scoredSignals.label: Executive Leadership & Business Translation
scoredSignals.description: Partnering with VP/CTO/C-Suite leaders to align technology investments with business strategy and capital allocation.

scoredSignals.label: Enterprise-Scale High-Availability Infrastructure
scoredSignals.description: Five-nines (99.999%) multi-region infrastructure reliability, latency SLAs, and mission-critical platform stability.

adviceCards.title: Articulate Multi-Team Strategic Roadmaps
adviceCards.recommendation: Demonstrate how your technical roadmaps guided 3+ engineering teams across multi-quarter strategic horizons.

adviceCards.title: Highlight C-Suite & Executive Alignment
adviceCards.recommendation: Highlight regular alignment with CTO/VP leadership on technology investments, organizational risk, and capital allocation.
